prompt: Directions: In this task, you are to write an essay on the necessity of developing social skills for college students. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
body: College is not only a place to gain knowledge but also a place to learn how to get along with others. For college students, developing social skills is a necessity rather than a choice.

First, good social skills make college life smoother and happier. Students who communicate well find it easier to make friends, resolve conflicts with roommates and work effectively in group projects. Second, social skills are essential for future careers. Employers value graduates who can express their ideas clearly, cooperate with colleagues and deal with clients. No matter how much knowledge people have, they will find it hard to succeed without the ability to work with others. Moreover, social skills help students build a wide network of relationships, which can provide support and opportunities in the future.

Therefore, college students should seize every chance to improve their social skills. They can join clubs, do volunteer work and take every opportunity to speak up in class discussions. Step by step, they will become confident communicators ready for the challenges ahead.

paper: 2022年12月大学英语四级 第2套
limit: at least 120 words but no more than 180 words
prompt: Directions: In this task, you are to write an essay on the importance of developing a healthy lifestyle among college students. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
body: Nowadays, many college students stay up late, skip breakfast and spend hours sitting in front of screens. These habits may seem harmless at first, but over time they can seriously damage their health. Therefore, it is important for college students to develop a healthy lifestyle.

A healthy lifestyle is, first of all, the basis of a strong body. Eating balanced meals, getting enough sleep and exercising regularly help students stay energetic and resist illness. In addition, it benefits their studies. A well-rested mind learns faster and remembers more, so students with good habits often perform better in class. What is more, a healthy lifestyle is good for mental health. Regular exercise and a stable daily routine can relieve stress and keep students in a positive mood.

To develop such a lifestyle, students should keep a regular schedule, limit their screen time and take part in sports. Habits formed at college often last a lifetime, so starting now is one of the best investments students can make in their future.

prompt: Directions: In this task, you are to write an essay on the role of physical exercise in achieving success at college. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
body: Many college students devote nearly all their time to study, believing that exercise is a waste of time. In fact, physical exercise plays an important role in achieving success at college.

First and foremost, regular exercise keeps students healthy and energetic. A strong body is the foundation for long hours of study, and students who exercise regularly tend to get sick less often. Second, exercise helps students study more efficiently. A short run or a game of basketball after hours of reading can relieve stress, clear the mind and improve concentration. In addition, team sports teach valuable qualities such as cooperation, persistence and the courage to face failure, which are important for success both at college and in the future.

Therefore, college students should make exercise part of their daily routine. Even thirty minutes a day, whether spent jogging, swimming or playing ball games, can make a big difference to their health and studies. Students who keep a balance between study and exercise will get the most out of their college years.

prompt: Directions: Suppose you are going to write a proposal to your student union for enriching students’ extracurricular activities. You are to write about what activities to organize and why. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
title: A Proposal for Enriching Extracurricular Activities
body: Extracurricular activities are an important part of college life, but at present most of the activities on our campus are limited to sports games and evening parties. To make students’ lives richer, I would like to propose that the student union organize the following activities.

First, the union could set up reading clubs in which students meet every week to share books and exchange ideas. This would not only broaden their knowledge but also improve their ability to think and express themselves. Second, I suggest holding regular workshops on practical skills such as photography, public speaking and basic coding. These skills are seldom taught in class but are very useful in daily life and future careers. Third, volunteer activities, such as tutoring children in nearby communities or helping at local nursing homes, should be organized more often, because they help students develop a sense of responsibility.
I believe these activities will appeal to students with different interests and help them develop into well-rounded individuals. I hope the student union will consider my proposal.

You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
title: A Proposal for Improving Library Service
body: As a frequent user of our school library, I would like to point out some of its current problems and propose possible solutions, in the hope of improving its service.

At present, the library has three main problems. First, it is hard to find a seat, especially before exams, because some students reserve seats with books and then leave them empty for hours. Second, many popular books and textbooks have only one or two copies, so students often have to wait weeks to borrow them. Third, the library closes at nine in the evening, which is too early for students who like to study at night.

To solve these problems, I suggest the following measures. The library could introduce an online seat reservation system that releases a seat if no one uses it for thirty minutes. It could also buy more copies of popular books and offer electronic versions whenever possible. Finally, extending the opening hours to eleven at night would greatly benefit students. I believe these changes will make the library a more welcoming place for learning.
